primary.title: Mizuho Markets Head Expects BOJ to Raise Rates Soon, More Often
primary.summary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc. expects the Bank of Japan to pick up the pace of interest-rate hikes, with the next one coming as soon as next month, as the weak yen and inflation prompt the central bank to act more quickly.
